%c[0,150,150,150]Trading and stashes like in GAMMA.

%c[200,200,50,50]• %c[0,150,150,150]Traders neither sell nor buy weapons, outfits and helmets - get gear from corpses, friends and stashes and repair it.
%c[200,200,50,50]• %c[0,150,150,150]Stashes only with coordinates: boxes in the world start empty, loot is only in stashes you have coordinates for (PDA, tasks, corpses). These stashes are richer in return (Treasure hunt).
%c[200,200,50,50]• %c[0,150,150,150]Applies to the whole playthrough and cannot be turned off later.
